description: Append-only raw vendor responses with separate provider, wall-clock receive and monotonic receive timestamps.

clock_rules.request_started_at: Offset-aware UTC wall-clock timestamp captured immediately before a request or stream wait.
clock_rules.received_at: Offset-aware UTC wall-clock timestamp captured immediately after the complete response or message is in memory.
clock_rules.received_monotonic_ns: Local monotonic clock reading paired with received_at; it is for ordering and latency deltas, not UTC reconstruction.
clock_rules.provider_updated_at: Provider field such as LastUpdate; never substitute it for received_at or snapshot_at.
clock_rules.snapshot_at: For a live capture, use received_at. Historical retrieval time does not prove an earlier live snapshot.

store_rules.raw_payloads: Write exact response bytes once under their SHA-256 content address.
store_rules.observations: Append one JSONL observation for every receipt, including duplicate payloads.
store_rules.overwrite: Never overwrite or truncate a raw blob or observation log.
store_rules.replay: Recompute normalized snapshots only from immutable raw blobs plus observation envelopes.
store_rules.integrity: Every observation must resolve to a blob whose bytes match payload_sha256 and payload_bytes.

security_rules.credentials: Read credentials from the environment only and never write them to URLs, logs, reports, manifests or exceptions.
security_rules.public_endpoint: Persist scheme, host and path only; strip query strings and fragments.
security_rules.rights: Authenticated capture requires a separate approved rights attestation with every Phase 2 research right explicitly true.
security_rules.documentation_examples: Documentation payloads and synthetic fixtures are never empirical observations or price-eligible evidence.
